rachel.m: Quick idea 1 4a1: convert webinar signups into immediate product activity. 'Webinar -> Quickstart Credit Bridge' 

devin.h: Walk me through the flow?

rachel.m: Short: attendee signs up -> gets 30 attendance hold credits after joining live -> if they join office hours and run one starter prompt within 24h they get a 100 bonus. Tie to cohort tag so Sales sees engaged attendees.

leo.p: Love that. Hypothesis: attendance + immediate hands-on will lift 7-day activation vs webinar-only follow-up. We'll track attendance_id, prompt_run_within_24h, bonus_claimed, paid_conversion_14d.

ops-bot: Ops notes: add utm_campaign=wb-quick-bridge, hubspot.lead_tag=webinar_quickbridge, LD flag wb_quick_bridge_flow. Add cooldown 48h for bonus claim.

devin.h: Experiment cohorts: wb_attend_bonus, wb_attend_no_bonus, organic_control. Allocation depends on signup source. Will we randomize within webinar registrants?

rachel.m: Randomize for attendees who opt in to the demo. We want to avoid impacting core webinar engagement. Target sample size ~2k registrants.

leo.p: Messaging: email after join "Thanks for attending 1 Claim 30 hold credits now; unlock 100 more in 24h if you run a demo prompt and stay for office hours." Keep CTA one-click to claim.

devin.h: Implementation: landing preloads the 3 starter prompts, one-click run, fire events: webinar_claim, prompt_run, bonus_unlocked. Add property webinar_cohort for analysis.

growth-bot: Suggest adding a short feedback micro-survey on unlock toast: 1-2 checkboxes to signal reason for trying (curiosity, evaluate for product, demo for team). Link eval: https://internal/evals/wb-quick-bridge

rachel.m: Timeline: mockups by EOD, LD flag + hubspot mapping tomorrow AM, soft internal launch with team next Wednesday, public webinar next Friday. Owners: Leo (experiment owner), Devin (events + infra), Ops-bot (flags + hubspot), Rachel (copy + comms).

leo.p: I'll draft the hypothesis doc and baseline webinar funnel metrics. Devin, can you confirm the 24h-run detection is trivial?

devin.h: Yep, we already have run timestamps. I'll add a quick analytic view and the dashboard tile for 72h.

rachel.m: Nice. Final ask: keep the copy explicit about "no CC" and that credits expire in 14 days. Short sync tomorrow 10am to finalize creatives. Thanks! :rocket:
